name: Helping
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively help those in need, demonstrating love through tangible acts such as providing food and drink to the hungry and caring for the poor, as seen in Deuteronomy and Matthew. Helping others is not merely charity but a command rooted in love, reflecting Christ’s command to love one another as He loved us, and is portrayed as lending to the Lord Himself, promising blessing and repayment. This help extends broadly—from assisting neighbors and friends to supporting members of the church and missionaries—emphasizing a generous and compassionate heart toward all.
